Hi Emma — thanks for the note and great meeting yesterday.

Attached is a concise snapshot (attached: Redwood_Hosted_Ratecard_Q2_2028.pdf and Model_Catalog_Shortlist.csv) — main highlights below so your team can model quickly:

Baseline per-1M token (hosted API, list rates):
- Input tokens: $3.00 per 1M tokens
- Output tokens: $9.00 per 1M tokens

Model roster (hosted) — short summary:
- ember-turbo-1: low-latency, cost-optimized for retrieval-augmented generation and chat; good for high-throughput pilots
- aurora-1-large: higher-quality generation for summarization and complex instruction following (larger context window)
- atlas-code: code-specialized model for transformations / data prep tasks (if you plan programmatic prompt pipelines)
- embed-v2: embeddings (semantic search, similarity) priced at $2.00 per 1k vectors — included in attached catalog

Pilot packaging (recommended for 3-month trial, ~60–120M tokens):
- Starter pilot bundle: 15% off list IO rates for commitments >= 50M tokens total over 3 months
- Pilot+ SLA: 25% off list IO rates + dedicated support (SLA windows, architecture review) for commitments >= 250M tokens over 3 months

Notes / clarifications:
- Listed rates exclude any applicable taxes.
- We can present a one-page mutual action plan if you want the pilot scoped formally (I attached a template).

If you'd like a worked example with your expected input/output split and model mix, send the rough proportions and I’ll drop a sample cost sheet.

Best,

Nikhil — thanks for pulling this together. Approve the starter bundle (15% off) for pilots in that band; it's inline with field guidance for limited, time-boxed trials. A couple of notes:

1) Embedding pricing: keep the embedded-vector pricing as a separate line item for the pilot (don't bake into IO discount). For pilots under 250M vectors, offer a 10% off vector rate as a courtesy.
2) Pilot structure: require a minimal mutually agreed scope (attached MAP) and an architect call within the first week — helps avoid unexpected token sprawl.
3) Upsell path: include a "conversion credit" — if they commit to an annual Reserved capacity within 60 days of pilot end, we can offer a one-time credit equal to 20% of pilot spend (applied to first month).

Ben — if you can draft the formal quote (line items: input per-1M, output per-1M, embed vector rate per 1k, applied pilot discounts, and MAP attachment), send back to Nikhil and cc Emma. Keep the quote valid for 30 days.
